title: “She was useful, but a bit too optimistic”: Augmenting Design with Interactive Virtual Personas

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews with UX designers, evaluating the Interactive Virtual Persona's tendency to exhibit over-optimism, uncritically agree with design proposals, and fail to provide realistic constraints or pushback.

Qualitative interviews and Likert-scale surveys assessing the diversity and completeness of the model's responses, identifying the risk of homogenized user viewpoints and culturally skewed perspectives.
